# ComfyDeploy

> ComfyDeploy is an open-source platform to run, share, and deploy ComfyUI workflows for teams on cloud GPUs (H100, A100, B200, H200, L40S, A10G, L4, T4).

- [ComfyUI Online Workspace](https://www.comfydeploy.com/comfyui-online-workspace): ComfyUI in the browser on managed GPUs with pinned custom nodes, shared models, version control, and one-click rollback.
- [ComfyUI Playground](https://www.comfydeploy.com/comfyui-playground): turns a ComfyUI workflow into a simple web app with auto-generated inputs for designers and PMs.
- [ComfyUI API](https://www.comfydeploy.com/comfyui-api): deploys a ComfyUI workflow as a production API with autoscaling serverless GPUs, staging/production, and TypeScript/Python SDKs.
- [Docs](https://docs.comfydeploy.com/): product and API documentation.
- [Pricing](https://app.comfydeploy.com/pricing)
- [Blog](https://www.comfydeploy.com/blog): ComfyUI tutorials and release notes.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/BennyKok/comfyui-deploy): source code.
